verdict.rationale: PagerDuty documents programmatic acknowledge and resolve through the Events API (follow-up events). It also ships an official MCP server that lets AI assistants securely manage incidents, and the REST API can manipulate account data. However, no evidence shows an agent explicitly escalating an incident through the API or MCP, and the MCP tool list for incident actions is not detailed. Missing for 10: documented API/MCP escalate action (reassign or escalate to the next level), explicit enumeration of MCP incident ack/resolve tools, independent hands-on corroboration of an agent running an end-to-end lifecycle.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, my agent can acknowledge, escalate, and resolve incidents end to end through a documented API or MCP connection — no dashboard in the loop

citations.quote: Follow up events can be sent to acknowledge or resolve an existing alert.
Connect AI tools to PagerDuty with MCP to securely manage incidents
enables AI assistants (like Claude Desktop, Cursor, or VS Code) to interact securely with your PagerDuty account
PagerDuty's MCP server allows you to fetch and manage information in your PagerDuty account.
Trigger, acknowledge, and resolve incidents created by service integrations.
